description: This Java class defines a command that modifies the definition of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, serializing to JSON, and managing command metadata.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinition
classes.description: A command class for modifying the definition of a thing, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and command metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyThingDefinition with specified thing ID, definition, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyThingDefinition instance from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the new definition for the Thing.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing that this command targets.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the definition as a JsonValue, in supported schema versions.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the 'definition' resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes command payload into JSON object builder based on schema version.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates that executing this command changes authorization details.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on class and fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on class, thing ID, definition, and superclass fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality, verifying the other object is of the same class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the command instance.
